description: Count the clips and hours a set of filters matches, with an estimated price for the tier and media. Free, needs no email, and reserves nothing. Use it to size a request before quoting.

filters.description: Optional filters: year_from, year_to, categories, countries, locations, query, exclude_people, min_duration_seconds, max_duration_seconds, require_4k_master, max_clips. describe_training_dataset documents each one.

media_resolution.description: proxy: 256x144 watermarked analysis proxies plus metadata. 4k: clean masters (4K UHD on nearly all) plus proxies, commercial tier only, paid by wire. Default proxy.

tier.description: evaluation (free, up to 100 clips), research (academic, $25,000 flat), or commercial ($3 per proxy clip or $10 per master clip, $10,000 minimum). Default commercial.

name: scope_training_dataset
title: Scope a Training Dataset
